items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Well, Manu originally, he'd tell me that he used to play

ctx.x: What did Bud Scott do? I want to get this started.

Well I believe if he didn't play it he was a great singer. And he was one of those guys that could make up his own song, rhyme a song, and he had a good powerful voice. The band couldn't play any louder and he could sing. And the band was built around him, from what I understand. Was he a big guy, a little guy? I think he was a kind of big fellow. Big head, I think. I think he had, to me, he had a pitch of something like that. He had a pitch of something like Jan Brushing that used to play with Count Basin, one…
Could Clayborne Williams' band fake it all then?
